data.name: Murdercartel
data.detailed_description:
Murdercartel

Enter a handcrafted online fantasy world where exploration, progression and adventure are at the heart of every journey.

Murdercartel is a 2D MMORPG that combines classic RPG progression with modern multiplayer systems. Battle dangerous monsters, conquer powerful dungeon bosses, gather valuable resources, craft powerful equipment and uncover an ever-expanding world filled with secrets.

Train your combat level alongside professions including Woodcutting, Mining, Harvesting, Skinning, Smelting, Weaving, Tanning, Lumbermilling and Crafting. Build your Collection Log, hunt rare loot, complete quests and compete with other players on global leaderboards.

Whether you enjoy exploring the open world, mastering professions, chasing rare drops or challenging difficult bosses, Murdercartel offers a long-term progression system designed to reward every adventure.

Key Features

  • Large handcrafted 2D fantasy world

  • Online multiplayer MMORPG

  • Challenging dungeons and epic boss fights

  • Class progression with unique abilities

  • Extensive gathering and crafting professions

  • Hundreds of weapons, armor and collectibles

  • Collection Log with discoverable content

  • Player marketplace and economy

  • World exploration with multiple unique regions

  • Minigames and competitive leaderboards

  • Frequent updates with new content

Begin your journey, forge your legend and become one of the strongest adventurers in the world of Murdercartel.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Broadband Internet connection required for online play.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.
